full_judgment:
3. After hearing the parties the learned trial Court decreed the suit and ordered the opposite party (the mother) to hand over the minor son Rafsan to the petitioner (the father) with some conditions for access of the child by the mother. 

 4. Being aggrieved, the present petitioner instituted Family Appeal No. 79 of 2015 in the Court of the learned District Judge, Dhaka which was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, Court No. 1, Dhaka who by his judgment and decree affirmed the judgment of the trial Court. However, the appellate Court made some remarks with reference to C. R. Case No. 314 of 2010 filed under section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act wherein the parties entered into an agreement with some conditions, including a condition to get the twin children of the petitioner and the respondent admitted into a residential school. The father of the children filed Civil Revision No. 1945 of 2007 before the High Court Division against the above condition set by the appellate Court.
